correctness.rationale: Derive exact local binary best-response condition on adjacent disagreement bits y: either they differ or both equal type bit. For each contiguous nonpinned path with fixed endpoint actions, parity(last XOR, last bit) reachability starts from states (0,0),(1,1), reaches 3 of 4 after one internal vertex, and >=3 after each further vertex; hence both endpoint parities possible, joining all pinned blocks gives a PNE. In alternating one-pin case, z_i=y_i XOR t_i forms a weakly decreasing binary word 1^ell 0^(n-ell); XOR closure forces ell congruent n/2 mod2, giving stated exact count. Direct independent bitwise payoff enumeration checked every pinned type vector for n=3,4,5,6 and all alternate single pin choices through n=10. It is finite corroboration only.
residual_risks: Finite checks only corroborate, not replace the all-parameter proof.

final_claim: Any binary conformist/rebel game on a simple undirected cycle C_n (n>=3) with at least one fixed-action stubborn player has a pure Nash equilibrium. Replacing one vertex on an originally alternating even cycle by a pin yields exactly n/2 equilibria if n=2 mod4 and n/2+1 if n=0 mod4, independent of fixed value or pin position.
